# x402 MCP Web Extract

Pay-per-use MCP server that settles with **x402 USDC micropayments** on Base mainnet.

## Connect

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "x402-web-extract": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://x402-web-extract.senpi-agent.workers.dev/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

## Tools (paid, pay-per-call)

| Tool | Price | Description |
|------|-------|-------------|
| `fetch_url` | $0.01 | Fetch any public URL as clean markdown or JSON |
| `token_price` | $0.01 | Real-time USDC spot price for any EVM token |
| `wallet_balance` | $0.02 | Native and USDC balance for any EVM wallet |

Payments are handled automatically by the `@x402/mcp` client — the wallet simply signs the x402 settlement. No subscriptions, no keys, no API tokens.

## REST fallback

The same tools are available as plain HTTP endpoints with x402 `payment-required` flow:

- `GET /fetch?url=<encoded-url>` — $0.01
- `GET /price?address=&chain=` — $0.01
- `GET /balance?address=&chain=` — $0.02

Discovery: `/llms.txt`, `/openapi.json`, `/.well-known/x402`, `/.well-known/agent-card.json`.

## Infrastructure

- Worker: `https://x402-web-extract.senpi-agent.workers.dev`
- Pay-to wallet (Base): `0xd44B22e6A97a26e0cC9615478962C9C9C2495ceC`
- Facilitator: CDP x402 (`https://api.cdp.coinbase.com/platform/v2/x402`)
- x402 spec: https://github.com/0xfabs/x402

toolsPreview.name: fetch_url
toolsPreview.description: Fetch any public URL and return a clean, readable markdown or JSON extract for AI agents. Pass the target as url (http/https). Costs 0.01 USDC on Base.

toolsPreview.name: token_price
toolsPreview.description: Real-time USDC-denominated spot price for an EVM token by contract address or common symbol. Provide address (0x...) or symbol (ETH, USDC, USDT, WETH) and optional chain (base, ethereum, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, avalanche, default base). Costs 0.01 USDC on Base.

toolsPreview.name: wallet_balance
toolsPreview.description: Query the native and USDC balance for any EVM wallet address. Provide address (0x...) and optional chain (base, ethereum, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, default base). Costs 0.02 USDC on Base.

toolsPreview.name: youtube_video
toolsPreview.description: Resolve any YouTube video URL (watch?v=, youtu.be, shorts, embed) to a direct MP4 download URL with title, uploader, and format metadata. Provide url (http/https). Costs 1.00 USDC on Base.

toolsPreview.name: youtube_audio
toolsPreview.description: Resolve any YouTube video URL to its audio-only stream download URL (m4a/webm when available) with title, uploader, and format metadata. Provide url (http/https). Costs 0.50 USDC on Base.
